༈de ltar rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud snod rung du byas nas 'bras bu 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i lam smin grol nye rgyu'i spyod pa

tei:div.tei:p: ༈ de ltar rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud snod rung du byas nas 'bras bu 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i lam smin grol nye rgyu'i spyod pa dang bcas pa mthar phyin rjes/ bcu gsum pa mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu sku dang ye shes kyi le'u la spyi don bzhi ste/ lam mthar phyin pas sku dang ye shes 'grub par bstan pa/ sku dang ye shes bshad pa/ de dag dbyings las byung zhing dbyings su thim pas mjug bsdu ba/ skabs kyi dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /spyi don dang po lam mthar phyin pas sku dang ye shes 'grub par bstan pa ni/

de ltar gzhi dang lam gyi rim pa legs par bshad nas/ da ni de dag gis grub pa 'bras bu'i don bstan par bya ste/ bshad ma thag pa'i tshul/ de ltar thabs dang shes rab mthar phyin nas/ /sku dang ye shes 'phrin las lhun gyis grub/ /de ltar lam gyi yon tan rdzogs pa na khams kyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas sam byang chub ces bya ba 'thob ste/ de'ang sems nyid 'od gsal ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la sgrib pa'i sprin tshogs mtha' dag dengs nas sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med cing lhun gyis grub pa'i nus pa ci yod pa mngon du thob pa nyid/ /rgyud bla ma las/ rang bzhin 'od gsal zhes brjod gang yin nyi dang mkha' bzhin glo bur gyi/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin tshogs stug pos bsgribs pa las ni bral gyur pa/ /dri med sangs rgyas yon tan kun ldan rtag brtan g.yung drung sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ni chos la mi rtog rnam 'byed ye shes dag la brten pas 'thob/ /ces so/ /de'i tshe gang gi don du chos sku dam pa dbyings gdod ma'i ngang na sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa brnyes pas sangs rgyas nyid kyi spyod yul las gzhan gyi ma yin pa rten gyi tshul du gnas pa ni/ de nyid las/ thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med/ /gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtogs pas/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong*/ /gzhal med gaṅgā'i bye ma las 'das pa/ /bsam med mnyam med yon tan rnams dang ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri med dbyings de ni/ / bag chags bcas pa'i nyes kun rnams spangs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de'i dbyings na snang ba'i chos sku dang*/ de las gdul bya'i ngor snang bar 'byung ba'i longs sku yang nam mkha'i zla ba 'phel 'grib med pa ltar rtag tu bzhugs nas/ sprul pa'i sku 'phro ba'i 'char gzhi mdzad par de las/ sna tshogs dam chos 'od zer snang ba'i skus/

/'gro ba'i rnam grol don grub la brtson pa/ /mdzad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal bzhin te/ /sna tshogs dngos kyang de yi rang bzhin min/ /'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang*/ /rab tu smin dang lung ston rgyu yi gzugs/ /gang yin de yang 'dir ni rtag gnas te/ /nam mkha'i khams su gzugs kyi khams bzhin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'jug pa las/ zhi sku dpag bsam shing ltar gsal gyur cing*/ /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin rnam mi rtog /'gro grol bar du 'jig rten 'byor slad rtag /'di ni spros dang bral la snang bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /skabs 'dir sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul las gdul bya la mi snang ba dbyings kyi sku gsum chos sku nyag gcig tu ro gcig pa nang dbyings phra ba'i ye shes su yod pa dang*/ de'i byin rlabs dang gdul bya'i smon lam las phyir gzhan snang du shar ba ye shes 'phrin las dag pa'i gzugs sku gnyis snang ba ni mkha' zla dang chu zla ltar shes par bya'o/ /deng sang ni/ kha cig gis ma phyed pas sku gsum gcig tu khas blangs dus dbyings kyi yon tan thams cad gdul bya la snang bar thal te/ de dang ngo bo gcig pa'i gzugs sku gdul bya la snang ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod na sangs rgyas khams dang la sogs pas gsal lo/ /des na 'di gnyis bye brag shes pa gal che'o/ /de ltar chos sku dang gzugs sku dam pa gnyis brnyes pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid do/ /de la theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pas ni de lta bu'i sangs rgyas ni sa bcu rgyun mtha'i dri ma mtha' dag spangs pa'i rjes la 'og min du sangs rgyas te longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku byang sems sa bcu pa'i snang ba la snang zhing*/ sprul pa du mas sems can gyi khams su gang la gang 'dul du ston to zhes 'dod do/ /sngags kha cig de dang mtshungs la/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po las ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan gyi spyod yul du mi snang ste/

snang na sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur la/ de'i ngang las snang ba sprul pa chen po dang*/ sprul pa sna tshogs pas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa'o/ /sprul pa chen po ni sa bcu pa'i sems dpa' la snang ba'i longs sku yin la/ sna tshogs pa ni mchog gi sprul pa la sogs pa tha lam pa rnams la snang nas don byed pa'o zhes 'dod pa yin no/ /de gnyis ka'i lugs kyi gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'og min du byang chub brnyes par 'dod de/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ yang dag sangs rgyas byang chub tu/ /'tshang rgya 'og min gnas mchog tu/ /sangs rgyas ma gyur 'dod khams su/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mi mdzad do/ /zhes pa dang*/ zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las/ 'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ / sangs rgyas phal po che las/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nang du chud pa ni gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa zhes bya la/ de lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa nang du chud pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho zhes bya ba yin la/ de ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad gang chen mtsho'i phyag gi mthil na gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa gang na bzhugs pa de ni stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams zhes bya ba longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i gnas yin la/ de'i nang na yod pa'i dum bu thams cad ni sprul pa sku'i gnas yin no zhes bshad pas/ gang na yod ce na/ gang du glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag spangs pas dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med cing sangs rgyas pa gang du brnyes pa de nyid kyi sa la 'og min du bshad de/ phyogs 'di kho na'o zhes gcig tu chad pa med do/ /rmi lam yang gnyid du gang song gi gnas der 'ong ba ltar chos mtshungs so/ /chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las/ dbang phyug chen po'i gnas mchog dang*/ /'og min de nyid rnam mdzes pa/

/shes pa gsum pa gcig nyid du/ / 'dres par gyur la bdag smra'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ theg bsdus las/ bdag tu 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir/ /gnas la tha dad yod ma yin/ /sngon gyi rjes su 'brangs pas na/ /de la gdags pas tha dad 'byed/ /ces so/ /gnas der ston pa shākya thub pa 'di sangs rgyas nas dus 'di tsam song zhes bsam par mi nus te/ ye shes rol pa'i rgyud las/ thog mtha' med pa'i dus dag tu/ / nga ni mngon par byang chub ste/ /zhes so/ /mi mjed 'dir tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su thog mar gtsang ma'i 'og min du sangs rgyas pa ltar bstan nas/ gdod 'dzam bu'i gling du sangs rgyas par snang ste/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du/ /sangs rgyas mngon par sangs mi rgya/ /gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du/ /'dod chags bral khyod der sangs rgyas/ /gtsang ma'i gnas dag spangs nas su/ / 'og min zhes bya nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po gcig 'dir 'tshang rgya/ /zhes so/ /de yang mi mjed kyi gnas thams cad bkod pa mnyam du snang ste/ nam mkha'i zla ba gcig nyid kyi rnam pa chu snod bye ba phrag brgyar dus snga phyi med par snang ba bzhin no/ / 'di tsam yang mtshon pa ste/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can gyi gnas ris so sor mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa dus mnyam pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa du mas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin no/ /gdul bya'i ngor 'og min de lta bur sangs rgyas par snang ngo*/ /bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi rang bzhin ni khams gsum las 'das pas gdul bya'i 'khrul snang gi bag chags kyi 'og min gzugs khams lta bu der bzhugs pa ma yin te bag chags thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rang snang dag pa'i 'og min khams gsum las 'das pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang bkod pa tshad med pa can du rtag par bzhugs te/ rgyan stug po bkod pa dang*/

nges pa'i mdo phal la snang zhing 'byung ba ni/ gzugs med 'dod dang gzugs khams dang*/ /'du shes med pa de bzhin te/ /gnas las 'das te sangs rgyas dbang*/ /bzhugs so stug po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /zhes pa dang*/ brtan pa stug po 'dus ma byas/ /zhes so/ /byang chub brnyes tshul yang*/ dri ma mtha' dag dang bral nas brnyes so/ / de la bral lugs ni glo bur gyi dri ma ste/ de yod pas sems can/ med pas sangs rgyas zhes tha snyad byas te/ de'ang dri ma rang bzhin pa sngar yod gsar du spangs pa'am/ yon tan sngar med gsar du bsgrubs pa ni ci yang med do/ / mdo sde'i rgyan las/ snga ma phyi mar khyad med kyang*/ /sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa/ /de bzhin nyid ni sangs rgyas 'dod/ /ces so/ /des na glo bur ba mtha' dag spangs par/ de nyid las/ gang la nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa'i sa bon dus ring rtag ldan pa/ /spong ba shin tu rgya chen rnam pa kun gyis rab tu bcom 'gyur cing*/ /gnas gyur chos dkar yon tan mchog rab ldan pa thob pa sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ni mi rtog shin tu rab dag yul chen ye shes lam gyis 'thob/ /ces so/ /de'i tshe gnas gyur kyang nyon mongs pa dag stobs kyis yon tan snang ba tsam la brjod kyi/ rgyu nyon mongs pa nyid 'bras bu yon tan du gnas gyur te ma dag pa dag par song ba ni mi 'dod de/ sdig pa dang nyon mongs pa kun du dag pa'i rgyu'am ngo bo ma yin mi srid do/ /bral bya'i dri ma bral stobs kyis de'i thad kyi yon tan snang ba la ltos te gnas gyur tsam zhig brjod na/ dug lnga gnas gyur pas ye shes lnga'o/ /kun gzhi gnas gyur pas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pas me long lta bu'i ye shes te/ sku gsum la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so zhes so/

/de bzhin du lhag ma gsum yang*/ de las/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dbyings su nub pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa dbyings su nub pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so zhes so/ / de'i tshe phyi snang ba zhing khams su gnas gyur/ nang phung po lha skur gnas gyur/ gsang ba tshogs brgyad ye shes su gnas gyur pas rnam pa kun tu sangs rgyas pa'o/ /ngo bo'i rgyu ni dang po'i khams la yon tan ye ldan du yod pa'i rigs de gnyis so/ /de'ang*/ rgyud bla las/ dang pos sku ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis/ /zhes pa la sogs pa bshad zin to/ /de'ang ngo bo nyid kyi sku sku gzhan gsum gyi chos nyid dri ma med pa dang*/ chos kyi sku stobs sogs kyi 'byung gnas dam pa dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dpes gang ba dang*/ sprul pa'i sku sems can mtha' yas pa'i don mdzad pa ste bzhir gsungs shing*/ de'i yon tan yang drug cu rtsa bzhi ste/ rgyud bla'i 'grel pa las/ de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang*/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang*/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis po de dag rnam pa gcig tu mngon par bsdus te drug cu rtsa bzhir 'gyur ro zhes so/ /mdo kha cig las sku gsum ye shes dang bcas pa ste/ gser 'od dam pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la sku gsum mnga' ste/ chos kyi sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ sprul pa'i sku'o/ /chos kyi sku ni yang dag pa'i ye shes nyid tsam du gnas pa la bya'o/ /sku gnyis po ni btags pa tsam mo/ /chos kyi sku ni yang dag pa ste sku gnyis kyi gzhi byed pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos kyi de bzhin nyid dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes las gud na sangs rgyas kyi chos med pa'i phyir ro/

/gsol pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes la rnam par mi rtog bzhin du 'phrin las la mnga' brnyes pa gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ dper na nyi zla dang chu dang me long la rtog pa med kyang gzugs brnyan 'byung ba bzhin du/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes kyang mi rtog pa bzhin du smon lam gyi dbang gis sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /sprul pa'i sku ni/ phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /chos kyi sku ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'o zhes pa dang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku dbye ba/ /rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ /gzhan ni sprul pa'i sku yin te/ /dang po gnyis pa'i rten yi no/ /zhes pa dang*/ sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdus par ni shes bya ste/ /sku gsum dag gis rang gzhan gyi/ /don 'di rten dang bcas par bstan/ /zhes so/ /rgyud bla ma dang mngon rtogs rgyan las sngar smos pa ltar sku bzhir gsungs te/ rgyud bla las/ chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba/ /gzhal med grangs med bsam med pa/ /mnyam med dag pa'i mthar thug pa'i/ /yon tan rnams dang yang dag par/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ldan te/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'dir ni dang po chos sku ste/ /phyi ma dag ni gzugs kyi sku/ /nam mkha' la ni gzugs gnas bzhin/ /dang po la ni tha ma gnas/ /zhes so/ /gsang sngags kha cig las sku gsum bde ba chen po dang bzhir 'dod de/ brtag gnyis las/ sku gsum yongs su shes pa ni/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor los brjod/ /ces so/ /yang*/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba las ni sku lngar bshad de 'di skad du/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /ces so/ / de thams cad kyang rigs dang yon tan gyi dbye bsdu tsam las/ don la tha dad pa med de sangs rgyas kyi sa'i chos kyi bsdu tshul so so ba tsam las ngo bo gcig yin pa'i phyir ro zhes bshad par bya'o/

/ spyi don gnyis pa sku dang ye shes bshad pa la/ zhi ba brnyes tshul/ dbyings dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par nang gsal du bzhugs tshul/ dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa gsum las/ zhi ba brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ da ni sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po'i rnam par gzhag pa nyid brjod de/ zhi ba brnyes pa'i tshul dang*/ sku'i rab tu dbye ba las/ re zhig dang po bshad pa ni/ lam gyi ye shes dag pa mthar thug pa de'i tshe spang bya khams gsum pa'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can rtog pa dang dpyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ sems dang sems byung kun gzhir bcas pa kun/ /chos kyi dbyings su 'jug pa rab zhi'i tshe/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med ro gcig gyur/ /de tshe dag pa gnyis ldan spro?s kun zhi/ /g.yo byed gzung 'dzin gyi rnam pas bsdus pa'i sems sems byung ni khams gsum pa'i sa pa ste/ ye shes snying po'i bden gnyis las/ sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa/ /sgro btags rnam pa can rtog yin/ /zhes pa lta bu rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad kun gzhi dang bcas pa sems nyid 'od gsal ba chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i ngang du zhi zhing thim pa de'i tshe/ /dbyings gdod ma'i gzhi dang ye shes thim bya'i rig pa gnyis su med par 'dres te ro gcig tu gyur pa ni ye nas dri ma med pa rang bzhin rnams dag dang*/ glo bur gyi dri ma cha dang bcas pa dag pa nyis ldan gyi chos sku dam pa ste/ spring yig bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*/ /mar la mar ni rjes zhugs ltar/ /shes bya spros bral de nyid dang*/ /dbyer med ye shes rnam 'dres pa/ /de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin chos sku zhes byar brjod/ /ces pa ste/ de'i dus su sems byung gi 'jug pa rgyun chad nas ye shes chen por ro gcig ste/ 'jug pa las/ shes bya'i bud shing skam po ma lus pa/
/bsregs pas zhi de rgyal rnams chos sku ste/ /de tshe skyes pa med cing 'gag pa med/ /sems 'gags pa de sku yis mngon sum mdzad/ /ces so/ /

dbyings dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par nang gsal du bzhugs tshul ni/ de'i tshe chos sku spros pa'i mtha' bral zhi ba chen po mngon du brnyes pas/ shin tu skye med 'od gsal snying po'i ngang*/ /gnam gang zla ba dbyings su nub pa ltar/ /phra ba'i ye shes mkha' dbyings pad+mor 'khyil/ /gang du'ang mi rtog zhib ba rnyes pa'i tshe/ /dag pa mthar thug pa ste/ 'od gsal gzhi'i ngang du phyin pas/ dbyings nam mkha'i ngang du ye shes gnam gang gi zla ba nang gsal thams cad mkhyen pa'i cha yon tan gyi rten nam 'char gzhir gnas pa las/ phyir snang longs sku'am gdul bya'i snang ngor snang ba ni ye yod pa ma yin te/ mtha' bzhi'i dri ma las 'das pa chos sku nyag gcig gi dus yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnam gang na nam mkha' la zla ba yod kyang gzhan gyis bltar rung ba'i mngon gsal du med pa bzhin du chos sku'i ye shes mkha' dbyings su 'khyil pa shin tu phra zhing zab pa'ang de bzhin te/ ye shes snang ba las/ dbyings su 'khyil bas mthong du med/ /med pa min te phra ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi sngon rol zla ba bzhin/ /zab pa zhi ba ches phra ba'o/ /zhes so/ / dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa la mi 'gyur rdo rje'i/ mngon par byang chub/ zhi ba chos kyi/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i/ cir yang sprul pa'i sku dang lnga las/ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku ni/ da ni dbye ba rgyas bar bshad pa la lnga las/ dang po mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku ni/ bsam brjod spros pa'i yul las 'das pa'i/ chos nyid mi dmigs dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i cha de la/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku zhes brjod pa ste/ /gzhi dbyings zad pa'i chos nyid mthar thug pa'o/ /de'ang gzhi gdod ma'i chos dbyings 'od gsal ba sangs rgyas kyi bgrod pa mthar thug de'i chos nyid 'pho 'gyur med pa'i cha de la mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku zhes brjod de/ ye shes bra ba las/

dbyings kyi dag pa rdo rje'i sku/ /mi 'gyur mi shigs bsam las 'das/ /zhes so/ / mngon par byang chub pa'i sku ni/ sku gnyis pa mngon par byang chub pa ni spangs rtogs mthar thug gi ngo bo ste/ 'di ltar/ rang bzhin glo bur sgrib gnyis rnam dag cing*/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho brnyes/ /spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin pas/ /stobs sogs pha rol phyin pa'i chas gzhal na/ /mngon par byang chub sku zhes btags pa ste/ / ma 'dres yon tan 'char gzhi mthar thug pa'o/ /sems nyid 'od gsal ba mthar thug gi tshe dag pa nyis ldan gyi cha la rtogs pa'i yon tan stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ thugs rje chen po/ chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa sngar smos pa'i mkhyen rab dang brtse ba'i nus pa yod pa'i cha nas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sku zhes bya ste ma 'dres pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi 'char gzhi gang yin pa'o/ /ye dra las/ dri ma bral phyir byang ba ste/ /yon tan rgyas pas chub pa nyid/ /gnyis med 'dres phyir zung 'jug phyir/ /mngon par byang chub skur brjod pa'o/ /zhes so/ / skyabs 'gro bdun cu pa las/ ma rigs gnyid las sangs phyir dang*/ /shes bya la yang blo rgyas phyir/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma'i 'dab ltar rgyas/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyud bla las/ sangs rgyas nyid ni dbyer med pa/ /dag pa'i chos kyis rab phye ba/ /nyi mkha' bzhin te ye shes dang*/ spangs pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid do/ /'od gsal byas min dbyer med par/ /'jug can gaṅgā'i klung gi ni/ /rdul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma grub dang*/ khyab dang glo bur ba nyid kyis/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa ni/ /sprin dang 'dra bar brjod pa yin/ /sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba yi/ /rgyu ni ye shes gnyis yin te/ /mi rtog pa dang de yi ni/

/rjes thob de ni ye shes 'dod/ /ces so/ / chos kyi sku la bzhi las/ rang bzhin bshad pa ni/ sku gsum pa zhi ba chos kyi sku ni dbyings mtha' las 'das pa'i ngang na shin tu phra ba'i ye shes sku dang ye shes kyi snying po zla ba mkha' dbyings su nub pa'i cha tsam du gnas pa ni/ shes bya'i yul la de blo mi 'jug cing*/ /shes byed blo la 'dzin pa mi dmigs kyang*/ /nang gsal mkha' dbyings nub pa'i zla ba ltar/ /thim la ma rmugs phra ba'i ye shes mchog /thams cad mkhyen chas 'char gzhi ngo bo'i tshul/ /de las gzugs sku rnam mkhyen mched 'gyur zhing*/ /gzhan la snang mdzad yon tan gter yin phyir/ /shin tu ches phra'i ye shes rab zhi'i chas/ /zhi ba chos kyi sku zhes rab tu brjod/ /dbyings sems nyid nam mkha'i ngang du ye shes ro gcig tu 'dres pa gnam gang lta bu'i tshe na/ spros pa'i tshogs rnams zhi la thams cad mkhyen cha ma 'gags pas thim la ma rmugs pa zhes bya ste/ nang gsal gyi ye shes mnyam gzhag gi cha la/ phyir gsal gyi ye shes mched pa'i snying po byed pa ste/ yul dang yul can gnyis su 'dzin pa med kyang*/ rtog med kyi ye shes khyad par can ni zhi ba chos kyi sku zhes brjod de/ sgyu 'phrul bla ma las/ ches phra'i ye shes nam du gsal/ /dmigs med 'char gzhi chos kyi sku/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyud bla las/ dri med rnam par rtog med dang*/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi yul yin phyir/ /chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba/ /zhes so/ /de'ang stong rkyang la chos skur mi 'dod de rig pa'i ye shes ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /chos nyid la chos skur 'dod pa ltar na rdo rje'i sku ste bshad zin to/ / yul la mi 'jug cing mu bzhi las 'das pa ni/ sku gsum po/ 'di dag phyi rol yul la mi 'jug cing*/ /chad pa ma yin shin tu phra ba'i phyir/ /rtag dang chad sogs mu bzhi'i mtha' las 'das/

/smra bsam brjod med pha rol phyin pa'i ngang*/ / stong pa'i rang bzhin dmigs pa rab zhi bas/ /rgyal ba rnams las gzhan gyi spyod yul min/ /bsam du med pa ste/ de'ang dbyings nang gsal du gnas pa'i sku 'di gsum ni phyir gsal du 'char ba'i rten yin pa nyid dang*/ rtag pa ma yin te dmigs bsam gyi yul du med pa'i phyir dang*/ chad pa ma yin te so so rang gi rig pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gnyis ka dang gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mu ma yin te rtag chad ma grub pas de'i mu khegs pa'i phyir ro/ / de'ang 'char gzhi byed pas na rgyal sras sar gnas rnams dang*/ sems can gyi tshogs la gzugs sku mig la snang ba dang*/ rna bar chos gsung thos pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i tshul khrims kyi dri snom pa dang*/ chos kyi ro myong ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin bde ba'i ro snang ba dang*/ rtog dpyod kyi shes rab kyis chos la 'jal ba rnams 'byung ba'i rgyu byed pa yang nang gsal gyi ye shes zla ba dbyings su nub pa lta bu'i nam mkha' bzhin du gnas pa las byung bas sangs rgyas las gzhan gyi spyod yul ma yin te/ rgyud bla las/ zag pa med khyab 'jigs med chos can te/ /brtan zhi rtag par 'pho med gnas yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' bzhin dam pa yis/ /dbang po drug don nyams su myong ba'i rgyu/ /'byung med gzugs don blta dang gtam bzang ni/ / gtsang ma mnyan dang bde gshegs tshul khrims kyi/ /dri gtsang snom dang 'phags chen dam chos ro/ /myong dang ting 'dzin reg bde nyams myong dang*/ / rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis zab pa'i tshul/ /rtogs pa'i rgyur gyur zhib mo bsam pa na/ /don dang bde mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rgyu mtshan rnams dang bral/ /zhes pa dang*/ rang gzhan don rten de la ni/ / bsam mi khyab sogs yon tan ldan/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yul/ / sangs rgyas shes gsum yul min phyir/ /ye shes lus can rnams kyis ni/

/ bsam mi khyab par rtogs par bya/ /phra phyir thos pa'i yul min te/ /don dam yin phyir bsam pa'i min/ /zhes so/ /chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar bzhugs tshul ni/ de lta bu'i ye shes mnga' ba'i cha la mnga' dbang rdzogs pa'i ston pa kun tu bzang po zhes bya ste/ de nyid/ chos dbyings pho brang shin tu skye med na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad rtag bzhusags kyang*/ /gcig gis gcig mi gzigs te chos nyid phyir/ /rang bzhin zab zhir bzhugs zhes gsungs pa yin/ /de nyid ngang du rgyal rnams dgongs klong gcig /bum mkha' snga phyi'i nam mkha' gcig pa bzhin/ /de ltar nang gsal gyi dus na chos nyid kyi zhing na ston pa kun tu bzang po chos kyi dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i gzhal med khang par dus gsum mam bzhi'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang dgongs pa snga phyi med par gcig tu bzhugs pa/ /bum pa snga phyi'i nam mkha' 'dres pa bzhin ye nas dbyer med pa nyid dus der ro gcig tu gyur nas chos nyid dmigs med du bzhugs pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang gcig gis gcig gi chos nyid de nyid mi gzigs te gzigs bya gzigs byed kyi yul las 'das pa rtag tu lhun gyis grub par bzhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang snying las/ gcig dang du ma bral ba yi/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ / sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs te/ /rang byung ye shes gnas med snang*/ / zhes so/ / chos sku ye shes kyi tshogs su bstan pa ni/ tshul/ 'di ni chos nyid stong pa shes rab dang*// ye shes tshogs dang rdzogs rim mthar thug pa'o/ /de'ang ye shes kyi tshogs mthar thug pa shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa stong pa nyid sgoms pas sems nyid kyi sgrib pa bsal ba'i tshe nang gsal chos sku mtha' dbus med pa'i dbyings rdzogs par mngon du byed pa yin te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdu na/ /rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs/

/zhes bshad pa'i don to/ / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis las mdor bstan pa ni/ da ni sku bzhi pa lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bstan pa ni nang gsal gyi dbyings nam mkha' lta bu/ de nyid ngang las rang snang longs spyod rdzogs/ /gnas dus ston pa chos 'khor phun tshogs las/ /dbyings nang gsal chos nyid kyi ngang las phyir gsal du rang snang ba'i longs sku nges pa lnga ldan snang ba ni rgyal tshab kyi ston pa rigs lnga ste stong gzugs ltar sangs rgyas nyid kyi snang ba las gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /zhing 'di'i gzhal yas khang pa la sogs pa ni rang snang gzhi'i 'od gsal las grub kyi/ ga shed na rang mtshan pa yod pa ni ma yin te/ rgyu 'phrul lam rim las/ lhun rdzogs rig pa rang snang ba'i/ /zhing dang gzhal yas gdan khri rgyan/ /'od zer du mar snang ba ste/ /zhes so/ / rgyas par bshad pa la gnas dus ston pa chos 'khor snang ba mjug bsdu ba dang sa bcu pas kyang mi mthong zhing sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul du bstan pa dgu las/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa la'ang gsum ste/ /ngo bo ni/ de la dang po/ gnas ni 'od gsal stug po bkod pa'i zhing*/ /lnga ldan 'od kyis lhun stug gsal zhing 'tsher/ /'ja' tshon gdangs gsal nam mkha' gang ba bzhin/ / steng 'og phyogs mtshams nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ /gzhal med khang mdzes sgo bzhi rta babs ldan/ /rtsig pa lnga dang pha gu dra phyed dang*/ /mda' yab pu shu gtsang khang phyur bus mdzes/ /rang snang 'od gsal stug po bkod pa rnam dag bde ba'i zhing ni/ snying ga'i ye shes kyi 'od lnga rang gsal ba'i gzhi mthar thug pa'i tshe snang ba ste/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams kyi nam mkha' thams cad 'od khyim bkod legs pa'i ra ba dang gur gyi snang ba kha dog phyed pas gsal ba dang 'od lnga bkrag tu 'tsher ba me long gi ngos la nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i dbus na/

/ye shes rin po che'i gzhal med khang 'og gzhi ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i steng na nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par gru bzhi lham par snang ba'i rtse mo bum pa zlum po gtsang khang phyur bu'i ya phibs can rin po che 'bar ba'i tog gis brgyan pa'i rdo rje phyed pas mdzes pa/ rtsig pa lnga'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser po bsgrigs shing*/ mda' yab phyir 'phyang gi bad kyi gdung sna las nor bu dang mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed nyi zla'i 'phyong dang bcas pa phyir 'phyang ba/ mda' yab kyi steng na pu shu mchod rten brtseg pa dkar pos mdzes par byas pa/ sgo bzhi sgo khyud dang bcas pa phyogs bzhir snang ba'i glo 'bur bzhis brgyan pa/ rta babs bang rim bzhi snam phran dang bcas pa 'od lnga'i ra bas mdzes pa ste/ gsang snying las/ 'og min gyi gnas mtha' dang dbus med pa na/ gzhi tshad med pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo gsal ba la/ /ye shes rin po che 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ rgya phyogs bcur yongs su ma chad pa/ yon tan dpag tu med par rgyas pa'i phyir gru bzhir gyur pa/ lhag pa'i ye shes rin po che'i glo 'bur gyis mdzes pa/ rtse mo phyogs bcu dus gzhi'i sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa thams cad dang*/ so so ma yin ngo bo gcig pa'i ye shes kun tu 'khyil pa zhes bya'o/ /rgyan ni/ gzhal yas khang de'i rgyan yang*/ rin po che dang dar gyi/ 'phan gdugs rnga yab dril bu'i phreng ba dang*/ /bla re rgyal mtshan la sogs nam mkha' gang*/ /'dod yon lha mo mchod pa'i sprin 'phro zhing*/ /'od zer 'khyil bas phyi nang kun tu khyab/ / dbus dang phyogs bzhi so so'i kha dog la/ /mthun pa'i rgyan dang kha dog rnam par bkra/ /che chung ma nges gang bltas de ltar snang*/ /grangs ni tshad med nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab/ /ji ltar til gyi gang bu phye ba bzhin/ /gzhal yas khang pa brgyan pa'i dar zab rin po che'i 'phan dang*/

/gdugs dang*/ ble re dang*/ rgyal mtshan la sogs pas nam mkha' gang bar brgyan zhing*/ mchod pa'i lha mos 'dod yon gyi sprin 'khrigs pas phyogs bcu gang bar rang byung ba/ gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus mthing ga la sogs pa ye shes kyi phyogs tshon gsal zhing*/ grangs mang ba til gyi gang bu kha bye ba tsam du nam mkha'i mthas gar khyab thams cad du khyab cing*/ tshad 'di tsam zhes ma nges pas gang bltas pa de tsam du snang yang mtha' mi mngon la/ 'od zer 'khyil bas mig 'phrul ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa ste/ gsang snying las/ ye shes rin po che sna tshogs kyi phreng ba dang*/ chun 'phyang dang*/ shar bu'i rgyan dang*/ gzugs sna tshogs dang*/ sgra sna tshogs dang*/ dri sna tshogs dang*/ ro sna tshogs dang*/ reg bya sna tshogs kyis phyogs bcur 'khrigs par rang byung la/ mi sgrib par gsal ba'i rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pas bklubs pa zhes so/ / gang na ni/ gzhal yas khang pa/ kun gyi nang na seng ge glang chen rta/ /rma bya shang shang nyi zla pad+mas spras/ /yon tan gyi brda don du ma mtshon pa'i phyir gdan khri de dag tu snang ba yang*/ de las/ mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khri dang*/ stobs glang po che'i khri dang*/ rdzu 'phrul rta'i khri dang*/ dbang rma bya'i khri dang*/ thogs pa med pa nam mkha' lding gi khri dang*/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gos pa med pa pad+ma rin po che'i gdan la zhes so/ /

dus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ gnyis pa/ dus ni ma nges gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med/ /dus gsum dus med kun tu bzang po'i dus/ /thams cad mnyam rdzogs chos nyid gdal ba che/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i ngang nyid do/ /dus phun sum tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa kun tu bzang po'i dus rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang ste/ mtshan brjod las/ dus gsum dus med rtogs par gnas/ /zhes pa'i dus so/ / ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rang bzhin dbyings kyi sku dang rig pa gdangs kyi sku ni/ gnas der bzhugs pa'i/ ston pa mtshan rdzogs dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin 'byung 'od dpag med/ /don grub lnga po lnga lngas bskor ba la/ /nam mkha'i dbyings phyugs rdo rje mā ma kī/ /sangs rgyas spyan dang gos dkar dam tshig sgrol/ /yab yum mnyam sbyor so so'i rgyan rnams rdzogs/ /mthing ga dkar ser dmar ljang 'od zer 'phro/ /'og gzhi zhi ba steng gzhi khro bo'i tshul/ /bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma kar/ /he ru ka dpal lnga lngas bskor ba yang*/ /kro dhā shwa rī lnga dang mnyam par sbyor/ /de sogs rnam pa brjod kyis mi lang ngo*/ /zhi ba'i sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi gtso bo rigs lnga yab yum 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pa yang tshul dgus 'og gzhi la bzhugs te/ sgyu 'phrul rngam glog las/ de lta'i sku mchog re re la/ /tshul dgu dag dang ldan pa ste/ /mnyen dang lcug dang 'khril bag dang*/ /ldem bag chags dang gzhon tshul can/ /gsal dang 'tsher dang lhun stug dang*/ /gzi byin 'bar bar rab tu gnas/ /zhes so/ /de'ang mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar bar bzhugs so/ /steng gzhi la khro bo rigs lnga yang tshul dgus bzhugs so/ /gang zhe na/ gal bo che las/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /dgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/

/gar dgu'i tshul gyis bsgyings pa'o/ /zhes so/ /dkyil 'khor yang*/ snga ma las/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas chen du/ /rak+ta'i dbal rlabs 'khrugs pa'i dkyil/ /keng rus ri rab 'bar ba'i steng*/ /me 'bar bsregs pa'i klong dkyil na/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ /tshad dang rgya yongs ma chad pa/ /phyi nang med par gsal ba'i 'od/ /'khor lo 'bar ba rtsibs bzhi pa/ /gru chad 'bar ba bzhis brgyan zhing*/ /gru bzhi sgo khyud 'bar bas mdzes/ /bar khyams gnyis ni 'bar bar gsal/ /nyi zla sbrul dang thod pas brgyan/ /khyu mchog dang ni ma he gzig /stag dang gtum po dom dag gi /sder mos dregs pa brgya byin dang*/ /tshangs pa dbang phyug bzung ba yi/ /gdan chen rnams kyang gsal ba 'o/ /'bus su 'jigs byed chen po ni/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /'gyur la lar/ stag dang gtum po dom dag ni/ /zung steng brgya byin tshangs pa yi/ /gdan chen rnams kyang gsal ba'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ni shin tu dag par mngon no/ /zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa kun tu khyab pas bsam gyis mi khyab brjod las 'das pa'o/ /de la mtshan dpe'i don ni longs sku'i ngo bo yin pas gang zhe na/ dang po mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ rgyud bla las/ legs gnas 'khor los mtshan pa dang*/ /yangs dang zhabs long mi mngon dang*/ /sor mo ring dang phyag zhabs ni/ /dra ba yis ni 'brel ba dang*/ / pags 'jam gzhon sha can legs nyid/ /sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang*/ / byin pa e na ya 'dra'i gsang*/ /glang po bzhin du sbubs su nub/ /ro stod seng ge'i dang 'dra dang*/ /thal gong bar med rgyas pa dang*/ /dpung mgo legs zlum phyag 'jam zhing*/ /zlum zhing mtho dman med pa dang*/ /phyag ring yongs su dag pa'i sku/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan dang*/ /mgrin pa dri med dung 'dra dang*/ /'gram pa ri dgas rgyal po 'dra/ /tshems ni bzhi bcu mnyam pa dang*/

/rab dkar tshems thags bzang ba dang*/ /rnam dag tshems mnyam nyid dang ni/ /mche ba rab mchog dkar ba nyid/ /ljags ring mtha' med bsam med pa/ /ro bro ba yi mchog nyid dang*/ /rang byung ka la piṅka yi/ / sgra dang tshangs pa'i dbyangs nyid dang*/ /spyan bzang ut+pal khyu mchog rdzi 'dra dang*/ /zhal mdzes dri med mdzod spu dkar ldan pa/ /gtsug tor dbur ldan dag cing srab pa dang*/ /pags pa gser gyi mdo 'dra sems can mchog /ba spu legs phra 'jam zhing re re nas/ /sku yi gyen du g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang*/ /dbu skra dri med rin chen mthon mthing bzhin/ /n+ya gro rdzogs pa'i ljon shing dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /kun tu bzang po dpe med drang srong che/ /sred med bu yi stobs mnga' mkhregs pa'i sku/ /bsam mi khyab 'bar sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /'di dag ston pas mi dbang mtshan du gsungs/ /zhes so/ /dpe byed bzang po brgyad cu ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*/ /mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams/ /zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang*/ /rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med/ /long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang*/ /seng ge glang chen bya dang ni/ /khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang*/ /mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags/ /byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tshams/ /gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku/ /mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ /sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang*/ /gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni/ /dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang*/ /sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang*/ /shin tu grims pa'i sku nyid dang*/ /yan lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang*/ /gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang*/ /dku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs dang*/ /phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni/ /zab dang g.yas phyogs 'khyil ba dang*/ / kun nas blta na sdug pa dang*/ /kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni/ /sme ba gnag bag med pa dang*/ /phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang*/ /phyag ris mdangs yod zabs ring dang*/

/zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang*/ /mchu ni bim pa ltar dmar dang*/ /ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang*/ /dmar dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang*/ /gsung mnyen 'jam dang mche ba zlum/ /rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang*/ /byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang*/ /mchog tu dag pa nyid dang ni/ / spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug /pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang*/ /smin tshugs ring dang 'jam pa dang*/ /snum dang spu ni mnyam pa dang*/ /phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang*/ /nyams pa rnam par spangs pa dang*/ /dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang*/ /dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang*/ /dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang*/ /stug dang 'jam dang dang ma 'dzings dang*/ /mi gshor dri zhim skyes bu yi/ /yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang*/ /dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni/ / g.yung drung 'khyil pas brgyan pa ste/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed/ /ces so/ / chos phun sum tshogs pa ni/ bzhi pa/ chos ni rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ / smra bsam brjod du med pa'i klong nyid do/ /snang ba de'i tshe gcig dang du ma med pa'i chos phun sum tshogs pa brjod du med pa ni/ kun byed las/ chos ni rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po ste/ /snying po lhun 'byams smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa la gnyis las/ zhi ba'i 'khor ni/ /lnga pa/ 'khor ni nyid las mi gzhan rang snang 'khor/ /sems dpa' brgyad dang de bzhin sems ma brgyad/ /sgo ba bzhi dang sgo ma rnam pa bzhi/ /zhi ba rang bzhin bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis las/ /drug ni gzhan la snang phyir sprul pa ste/ /gnyis ni dbyings na gnas phyir chos kyi sku/ /rang snang zhi ba longs sku sum cu bzhi/ /khyad par 'khor ni nyi shu bzhir gnas so/ /rang snang longs sku'i zhing na gtso 'khor du snang yang bzang ngan med pas ye shes gcig gi rol par rang shar ba ste/ sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/ rang snang rgyal ba sems stsogs dang*/

/dang po'i sangs rgyas sa rgyal ba/ /sems dpa' che dang 'joms pa che/ /zhes so/ /de la zhi ba'i sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis las/ kun bzang yab yum ni nang gsal chos sku'i ston par dbyings na bzhugs pas 'dir mi snang ngo*/ /thub pa drug ni gdul bya'i snang bas bsdus pas 'dir mi snang ngo*/ /gtso bo lngar byas na yum dang bcu dbus kyi gtso bo la/ /sems dpa' brgyad/ sems ma brgyad/ sgo ba yab yum brgyad de nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin la/ gtso bo rnam snang yab yum du byas dus/ rigs bzhi yab yum brgyad dang sum cu rtsa gnyis ni 'khor du rang snang ba'o/ / khro bo'i 'khor ni/ de bzhin du steng gzhi/ khro bo'i 'khor ni kau sing phra men brgyad/ /sgo skyong bzhi dang dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad/ khro bo rang bzhin lnga bcu rtsa brgyad las/ khyad par 'khor ni bzhi bcu brgyad dang bcas/ /'bar ba'i cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /shin tu mi bzad gar dgus rol pa 'o/ / gtso bo yab yum lngar byas na 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad la bud+dha he ru ka yab yum dang bcas te gnyis su byas na lnga bcu rtsa drug 'khor du rang snang ba thams cad kyang 'jigs su rung ba'i rngam stabs 'bar bas nam mkha'i dkyil na bzhugs pa ste/ slob dpon chen pos/ sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ /dgod dang gshe dang drag shul chen po dang*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba'i tshul ston pa/ khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas so/ / rang snang gzhan snang bshad pa ni/ de ltar sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa las/ tshul/ gzhan yang lus grub dkyil 'khor ji snyed pa/ /de snyed rang snang longs sku'i zhing khams yin/ /gzhan snang gdul bya'i zhi khro ji snyed pa/ / sprul skus bsdus phyir rang snang longs sku min/ /'di ltar gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ kye'i rdo rje dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa'i rgyud bla na med pa las lus grub kyi dkyil 'khor gsungs pa yang rang snang longs sku'i snang ba yin gyi gzhan la snang ba ma yin no/

kha cig las bgegs dang log 'dren 'dul ba'i don du khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spros pa dag ni sprul pa'i sku yin gyi 'og min gyi zhing gi dkyil 'khor ma yin te/ bgegs de dag gi rang snang gi dkyil 'khor yin pa'i phyir rmi lam bzhin no/ / de dag gi mjug bsdu ba ni/ da ni mjug bsdu ba bstan pa ni/ rang snang longs sku'i snang ba chen po rang bkod pa/ de ltar phun sum tshogs pa rnam lnga'i zhing*/ / thams cad rang snang yin phyir bzang ngan med/ /kun kyang gsal 'tsher lhun stug 'od zer 'phro/ /lham me lhan ne lhang nge'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ /'di ni 'dren pa rnams kyi spyod yul te/ /gcig gis gcig gzigs de yi bsngags pa brjod/ /ye shes phyir gsal du snang ba'i zhing gi gtso 'khor la bzang ngan med de rgyud gcig gis bsdus pa'i rmi lam bzang ngan nam gtso 'khor du snang yang don la bzang ngan med pa bzhin/ don nang na yod pa'i rtags phyir shar ba'i zhing dang gzhal yas khang dang 'od dang gtso 'khor la sogs pa rnams sgrib pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud gcig gis bsdus pa'i rol pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag kyang thugs rnams par mi rtog pas lham me ba dang*/ gsung brjod bral chen pos lhan ne ba dang*/ sku gzi brjid chen pos lhang nge bar bzhugs pa yin no/ /'di dag phyir snang du mthong ba dag pa'i spyan gyi dkyil 'khor la rang snang ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig gis gcig bsgribs pa med par gzigs pas yon tan dang bsngags pa brjod res mdzad pa yin no/ / dag pa sa bcus kyang mi mthong ba'i tshul ni/ snang ba 'di nyid sa bcu'i sgrib pa/ de ltar yid 'ong kun nas bkod pa'i zhing*/ /dag pa'i gdul bya yis kyang mthong mi nus/ /sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar gyi sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas nyid kyi rang snang ba'i longs sku mi mthong ste/ da dung sgrib pa mtha' dag dang ma bral ba'i phyir ro/

/de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi khams dang yon tan dang 'phrin las la sogs pa nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par mtha' yas pas kyang blta bar mi nus te/ rang gi sa pa tsam las yon tan mtha' dag la gzigs pa dag pa'i blo mig ma thob pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud bla las/ sangs rgyas khams dang sangs rgyas byang chub dang*/ /sangs rgyas yon tan sangs rgyas 'phrin las te/ /dag pa'i sems can gyis kyang bsam bya min/ /'di ni 'dren pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ dag yul min phyir don dam gyis bsdus phyir/ /rtog gnas min phyir ngang las 'das pa'i phyir/ /bla na med phyir srid zhis ma bsdus phyir/ /rgyal yul 'phags rnams kyis kyang bsam mi khyab/ / ces pa dang*/ bla med ye shes thugs rje che sogs yon tan gyis/ /yon tan pha rol phyin pa'i rgyal ba bsam mi khyab/ /des na rang byung rnams kyi tha ma'i tshul 'di ni/ /drang srong chen po dbang thob rnams kyis kyang rig min/ /zhes so/ / sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul du bstan pa ni/ 'o na su yi yul yin zhe na/ rang snang stong gzugs bzhin du bsam mi khyab/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi rang snang ngo*/ /'di ltar rlung dbu mar chud pa'i tshe rnal 'byor pa rnams la stong pa nyid kyi gzugs brnyan rang la snang yang gzhan gyis mi mthong ba bzhin du/ sangs rgyas la snang ba'i zhing snang de yang byang chub sems dpas mi mthong yang sangs rgyas la rtag pa rgyun gyi khor mor snang ste/ lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings kyi snang ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang snying las/ ye shes thig le de nyid la/ /ye shes thin le nyid snang ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bsam yas mchog /phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi/ /zhing khams bsam yas rnam dag dang*/ /rgya dang bral ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ /'khor lo'i rgyan dang rol mo'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor ma lus bsam yas kun/ /mthong nas nye bar mnyes pa dang*/ /rgya chen gsung las don 'byung ba'ang*/

/mthun pa'i ye shes rang snang ba'o/ /zhes so/ /de la ye shes kyi thig le ni sangs rgyas kyi mthong ba dag pa'i spyan te/ mtshan brjod las/ ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /ces pa'o/ /ye shes thig le nyid snang ba ni rang snang gi zhing 'ja' 'od gdangs gsal ba'o/ / bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni snang ba de 'dra ba sangs rgyas gzhan rnams kyi snang ba la snang ba'o/ /bsam yas mchog kyang de nyid de tshad med pa'o/ /phyogs bcu ni shar la sogs pa dang*/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi sangs rgyas gsum dang ma nges ba 'og min na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas te dus bzhir rdzogs pa'i rang snang ngo*/ /de yang zhing khams bsam yas rnam dag dang zhes pa rang snang gi zhing ste sangs rgyas gcig gis gcig gzigs so zhes pa'o/ /rgya dang bral ba'i gzhal yas la sogs pa ni 'od gsal rang snang gi zhing ngo*/ / gsung las don 'byung ba ni brjod du med pa'i gsung de nyid kho na gsung gi don de go bar mdzad pa'o/ /mthun pa'i ye shes ni gtso 'khor rtogs pa gcig ngo bo gcig dbyer med par mthun pa'o/ /rang snang ba ni sangs rgyas de nyid kyi spyan la snang gi sems dpa' la sogs pa gzhan la mi snang ngo zhes pa mtshon pa'o/ /

sprul pa'i sku la yang mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad gnyis kyi/ mdor bstan pa ni/ sku lnga pa sprul pa'i sku ni rgyal sras 'phags pa la sogs pa zhi ba'i gling du 'khrid par byed pas ded dpon dam pa'i ston pa zhes bya ste/ de'ang gdul bya mchog la snang ba gzugs brnyan longs sku dang*/ phal pa la snang ba sna tshogs sprul pa gnyis las/ dang po ni 'og min la sogs pa'i nges pa lnga ldan du snang la/ gnyis pa ni bzo la sogs pa so so'i skye bo dang nyan rang gi don mdzad pa'o/ /sprul pa de gnyis gang las 'char zhe na/ rang snang longs sku'i zhing*/ de nyid ngang las gdul bya'i 'jig rten du/ /'dul byed ston pa rim gyis snang ba ni/ /rang bzhin 'gro 'dul sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /rnam pa gsum gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /rang snang gi ngang las slar gdul bya la snang ba'i sku mched nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad de/ de'ang rang bzhin sprul pa dang*/ 'gro 'dul sprul pa dang*/ sna tshogs sprul pa'o/ / rgyas par bshad pa la rang bzhin 'gro 'dul sna tshogs sprul sku gsum gyi/ rang bzhin sprul sku la yang gnas dang ston pa/ ye shes/ chos dang 'khor/ dus/ sbyang bya'i khyad par/ zhing dngos dang drug las/ gnas dang ston pa ni/ thog mar sems dpa' rnams la snang ba gzugs brnyan longs sku'i ston pa ni rang snang longs sku dang cha 'dra la dngos ma yin pa bzhin dang me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas bshad par bya ba'i tshul las/ de yang rang bzhin sprul sku'i ston pa ni/ 'og min mngon dga' dpal ldan pad+ma brtsegs/༷ /las rab grub pa'i 'jig rten rnam pa lngar/ /rnam snang mi bskyod la sogs rigs lnga'i sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad 'od zer 'bar ba la/ /zhi dang khro tshul dpag med tshul 'char bas/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzad/ /dag pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang ye shes lnga dang sku lnga thob par byed cing*/

nyon mongs pa lnga sbyong ba la ltos nas rigs lnga'i ston pa dang zhing dang chos dang grogs la sogs par snang ba ste/ dbus 'og min na ston pa rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ shar mngon dgar rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ lho dpal dang ldan par rin chen 'byung gnas dang*/ nub pad+ma brtsegs pa'am bde ba can na 'od dpag med dang*/ byang las rab grub par don yod grub pa rnams mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku chu'i zla ba ltar rang snang longs sku'i ci 'dra bar snang ba ste/ rgyud bla las/ ji ltar sprin med nam mkha'i zla ba'i gzugs/ /ston ka'i chu sngon mtshor ni mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal sras tshogs kyis khyab bdag gzugs/ /rdzogs sangs dkyil 'khor nang du mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /ji ltar na/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ /dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag nyid ni/ /theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ /thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed/ /ces pa'i tshul lo/ /de'ang nang gsal las rang snang ba'i longs sku nam mkha'i zla ba lta bu'i gzugs brnyan sems dpa' la snang ba ni longs spyod rdzogs sku gnyis pa sems dpa' rnams tshim par byed pa dang*/ sprul sku rnams rnam par dag pa'i dbyings la brten pas ring ba dang nye ba zhes brjod de/ rgyud bla las/ mthong na tshim byed yon tan gang*/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes bya ba/ /sprul pa chos la rdzogs par ni/ /longs spyod gzugs sku gnyis la brten/ /dag las nye dang ring rnams la/ /'jig rten rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /chu dang nam mkhar zla gzugs bzhin/ /de mthong ba ni rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes so/ /de'ang dag dbyings longs sku sangs rgyas kyis mthong ba dang*/ gzugs brnyan longs sku sems dpas mthong ba gnyis so/ /zhar la mchog gi sprul pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa yang de'i cha mthun yin pas so so'i skye bo la sogs pas mthong ba la sbyar ba yin no/

/ye shes la'ang mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis las/ mdor bstan pa ni/ sems dpa' la snang ba'i longs sku/ de yang ye shes lnga lnga'i rang bzhin te/ /chos dbyings me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya grub ye shes rnam pa lnga po yang*/ /re re'i 'khor du bzhi bzhi ldan pa ste/ /thams cad ro mnyam gcig gi ngang nyid do/ /ston pa lnga la ye shes lnga lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga ldan pa yang rang bzhin rgyud gcig gi ngang las ma g.yos so/ /'di ltar rnam snang la chos dbyings ye shes/ mi bskyod pa la me long ye shes/ rin 'byung la mnyam nyid ye shes/ snang mtha' la kun rtog ye shes/ don grub la bya grub ye shes gtso bor ldan la gzhan bzhi po 'khor du ldan pa yin no/ / rgyas par bshad pa la lnga las/ chos dbyings ye shes ni/ ye shes de dag gang zhe na/ dang po/ chos dbyings ye shes shin tu mi g.yo ba/ /gzung 'dzin spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa yin/ /gti mug dbyings su zhi bas spros pa dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'i ye shes te/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mdo las/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni dper na nam mkha'i gzugs su gyur pa thams cad na yod kyang de'i rang bzhin brjod par bya ba ma yin pas sna tshogs su med par ro gcig go /de bzhin du chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyang shes bya thams cad la yod kyang brjod par bya ba ma yin pas sna tshogs ma yin pa'i phyir ro gcig go zhes so/ /me long ye shes ni/ ye shes gnyis pa/ me long ye shes gsal stong 'char gzhi'i tshul/ /ye shes kun gyi 'byung gnas chen po yin/ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa rnam shes gzhan rnams kyi mched pa'i 'char gzhi can dbyings su nus pa las ye shes lhag ma gsum gyi 'char gzhir gyur pa me long dag pa'i ngos lta bu gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma med pa ni/ de nyid las/ me long lta bu'i ye shes ni dper na me long go ngos la gzugs brnyan snang yang yod pa ma yin te rtsol ba yang med/

mngon par 'du bya ba yang med do/ /de bzhin du me long lta bu'i ye shes la thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzugs brnyan sna tshogs byung yang yod pa ma yin te rtsol ba dang mngon par 'du bya ba med do zhes pa dang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ me long ye shes mi g.yo ste/ /ye shes gsum ni de la brten/ /mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa kho na'o/ /zhes so/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ni/ /gsum pa/ mnyam nyid ye shes chos kun mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /'khor 'das gnyis med mnyam rdzogs chen po yin/ /nga rgyal dbyings su zhi bas bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du mkhyen cing 'khor 'das gnyis su med pa ni/ mdo de nyid las/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni chos thams cad mtshan nyid med par mnyam pa nyid khong du chud cing bde ba dang sdug bsngal ro gcig pas mnyam par grub pa'o zhes pa dang*/ snga ma las/ mnyam nyid ye shes sems can la/ /sgom pa dag pa la 'dod de/ / mi gnas zhi bar zhug pa ni/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yin par 'dod/ /ces so// kun rtog ye shes ni/ bzhi pa/ kun rtog ye shes shes bya ma 'dres mkhyen/ /ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa rnam dag yin/ /'dod chags dbyings su nub pas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes shes bya ji lta ba gshis stong pa nyid dang*/ ji snyed pa snang ba sna tshogs pa'i ngo bo rgyu 'bras thams cad mkhyen pa ste/ mdo de las/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni dper na 'jig rten gyi khams na gling dang nyi zla la sogs pa so sor phye ba yin no/ /de bzhin du so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang*/ rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par grub pa so sor mkhyen to zhes pa dang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /shes bya kun la rtag mi thogs/ / ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi/

/gter dang 'dra ba kho na yin/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ni/ /'byor pa thams cad ston mdzad cing*/ /the tshom thams cad gcod mdzad pa'i/ /chos chen char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /zhes so/ / bya grub ye shes ni/ lnga pa/ bya grub ye shes 'phrin las phun sum tshogs/ /shes bya kun la rtag thogs med pa yin/ /phrag dog dbyings su nub pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad par thogs pa med pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes ni/ mdo de nyid las/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni dper na sems can rnams kyi lus dang ngag dang yid kyi bya ba grub par byed do/ /de bzhin du bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni sku dang gsung dang thugs kyis sems can gyi don lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa'o zhes pa dang*/ snga ma las/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ /khams rnams kun tu sna tshogs shing*/ /dpag med bsam yas sprul pa yis/ /sems can don kun 'grub pa'o/ /zhes so/ / chos dang 'khor ni/ bzhi pa/ gdul bya'i 'khor ni sa bcu'i sems dpa' la/ / chos ni ting 'dzin 'od zer rab bkye bas/ /sa de'i sgrib pa sbyong ba'i blo skyes nas/ /ser sna la sogs spangs te rgyal la blta/ /da dung de 'dra'i ston pa rnam dag dang*/ /bdag nyid khyad par mthong nas sgrib pa sbyong*/ /kun tu 'od kyi bar du 'god pa ste/ /gzugs bzang me long bstan pas don mdzad do/ / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste/ 'grel chung las/ byang chub sems dpa' sa chen po la bzhugs pa rnams dang thabs cig tu theg pa chen po'i chos kyi longs spyod kyi dga' ba dang bde ba shin tu kha na ma tho ba med par nye bar spyaud pa'i phyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin no zhes so/ /de'ang chos phun sum tshogs pa theg pa chen po 'od zer bkye bas snang bar mdzad de/ me long bltas pas byad kyi dri ma sel ba ltar/ sems dpa' des ston pa longs sku la bltas pas rang gi de'i sgrib pa mthong nas ser sna la sogs pa rim pas sbyangs te ston pa la blta zhing*/

de dang bdag dag ma dag khyad zhugs par mthong nas/ slar yang go ba brdas mtshon pa'i chos nang shar du 'byung bar byin gyis rlob cing 'od zer bkye bas sgrib pa sel bar byed do/ /gsang snying las/ 'og min bla med gnas mchog tu/ /sku ni rnam par snang mdzad tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams la/ /de bzhin gsung mchog mi smra ste/ /sku yis chos rnams 'jal bar ston/ /me long bstan pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /dngos kyi mdog ngan thams cad sel/ /'khor gyis de bzhin sku bltas na/ /byang chub sgrib pa gting dpag med/ /me long bzhin du sku la snang*/ /de nas sa bcu rim gyis 'byang*/ /bla med byang chub yang dag 'thob/ /ces so/ / dus ni/ lnga pa/ dus ni 'gro grol bar du rgyun mi 'chad/ /longs sku'i zhing na khor mor snang ba yin/ /sems dpa' sa bcu la bzhugs pa rnams byang chub ma thob pa de srid du bzhugs pas mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dus te rtag pa rgyun gyi khor mor bzhugs pa yin te/ 'jug pa las/ 'gro grol bar du 'jig rten 'byor slad rtag /ces pa dang*/ rgyud bla las/ chos kyi dbang phyug 'chi ba'i bdud bcom dang*/ /ngo bo med phyir 'jig rten mgon po rtag /ces so/ / zhing dang ston pas sbyang bya'i khyad par la gnyis las/ rnam snang gi ni/ tshul/ de ltar rigs lngar nges pa'i rang bzhin yang*/ /gdul bya'i gti mug shas cher sbyong ba'i tshe/ / zhing ni 'og min ston pa rnam snang la/ /chos ni chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dri ma nyon mongs pa lnga'i rim pas ston pa dang chos lngar snang ba'i dang po gti mug gi dri ma sbyong dus rnam snang las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi chos 'og min du thos pa'i rigs gzhan bzhi'i ni/ tshul/ de bzhin zhe sdang sbyang phyir mi bskyod zhing*/ /nga rgyal rin 'byung 'dod chags 'od dpag med/ /phrag dog sbyang phyir don grub snang ba yin/

/zhe sdang la mi bskyod pas me long ye shes kyi chos ston la/ nga rgyal la rin 'byung gis mnyam pa nyid dang*/ 'dod chags la 'od dpag med kyis so sor rtog pa dang*/ phrag dog la don yod grub pas bya grub ye shes bstan pas sbyong ba yin no/ /de'ang sa bcu po la rigs lnga chos lnga gnas gyur lnga gsungs te/ mthong lam gyi dus su kun brtags pa'i gti mug gnas gyur chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob rnam snang mthong*/ sgom lam chung ngu gsum du nga rgyal gnas gyur mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes thob rin 'byung mthong*/ 'bring gsum du rnam pa thams cad pa'i 'dod chags gnas gyur so sor rtog pa'i ye shes thob snang ba mtha' yas mthong*/ chen po'i sa brgyad pa la zhe sdang gi sa bon rtog pa'i zug rngu dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur me long lta bu'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa thob mi bskyod pa mthong*/ dgu pa dang bcu par phrag dog gi sa bon dag sgo lnga'i zhing dag par so sor yang dag rig bzhis sems can gyi don byed pa'i 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes thob don grub mthong nas 'od zer chen pos dbang bskur te sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa chen po rdzogs par 'gyur ba nyid/ sgyu 'phrul mngon byang las/ dag pa sa yid dbang nyid phyir/ /ston pa lnga dang chos rab lnga/ /ye shes lnga yongs rdzogs pa las/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub snying por 'gro /zhes so/ /de'i 'grel ba ji lta ba bzhin bkod do/ / zhing dngos la gsum las/ 'khor dang ston pa'i khyad kyis phyed sprul ni/ gzhan snang rigs lnga'i zhing dang ston par snang bas sems dpa'i don mdzad pa'i tshul 'di nyid/ de ltar ston pa longs spyod rdzogs na yang*/ /'khor sogs ston pa nyid las gzhan yin pas/ /thams cad longs spyod rdzogs min de yi phyir/ /phyed sprul nyid de rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku/

/dag pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snang ba yin/ /sar gnas rnams las gdul bya gzhan la min/ /de phyir phyed snang sprul pa'i sku zhes bya/ /longs sku mtshan nyid pa'i zhing na thams cad bzang ngan med par rdzogs pas rtag tu 'pho 'gyur med la/ sems dpa' la snang ba'i longs sku ni gzugs brnyan du mtshan dpe la sogs pa ston pa'i longs spyod rdzogs par snang yang 'khor dang zhing la sogs pa gzhan du snang zhing sa bcu pa'i snang bas bsdus pa yin pas phyed sprul longs sku zhes bya bar nyi zla kha sbyor la sogs pa'i rgyud du gsungs so/ /zhing 'di yang sa bcu pa'i sems dpa' las gzhan la mi snang ba'i phyir yang phyed sprul zhes bya la/ longs skur snang yang dngos rang snang las gzhan ma yin pas de'i gzugs brnyan phyed pa ltar snang ba'i phyir na'ang phyed sprul zhes bya ste rang snang gi rang bzhin 'phrul pas rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku zhes kyang bshad do/ / zhi ba'i zhing bzhi ni/ de lta bu'i/ zhing de khod mnyam yid 'ong gzhal med khang*/ / rin chen bdun ldan 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ /pad+ma las skyes rgyal sras dpag tu med/ /longs spyod sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i char pa 'bab/ / dus bzhir chos gsung dri med g.yer kha'i sgra/ /dpag bsam rin chen chu mtshos rab tu mdzes/ /'di ni zhi ba rang bzhin sprul pa yin/ /rigs lnga'i zhing de na rin po che sna bdun gyi sa gzhi la gzhal med khang 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba rin po che'i dra bas brgyan pa dang*/ ta la'i ljon par dril bu tshar du bsgrengs pa las stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi sgra sngar ma thos pa nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa zhi bar byed pa rnams rang 'byung ba/ rdzing bu yan lag brgyad ldan sprul pa'i chu byas brgyan par rtse ba las nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba sel ba dang*/ gang ci 'dod pa thams cad nam mkha' las char du 'bab pa la sogs te sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rmad du byung bas bskrun pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i bkod pa tshad med pa ni mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing gi yon tan bkod pa dang bde ba can gyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa la sogs pa'i mdo las rgyas par 'byung ba bzhin no/

/de dag kyang rang gi dge ba'i sems kyi snang ba tsam las gzhan dag rtog 'dod can ma dag pas logs shig tu bgrod nas phyin du yod pa ma yin te/ dge ba'i bag chags las rmi lam bzang po 'byung ba ltar sems dpa' rnams la rang snang ba ni sangs rgyas kyi phyed sprul dang thun mong du spyod pa mthun par snang ba'o/ /gsang snying las/ dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin gyi/ /rin po che dang 'byung ba kun/ /de dag rdzas yod ma yin te/ /rang sems bsod nams brtas pa yin/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul rmad kyi chos/ / gzhan nas yod 'ongs ma yin te/ /thabs la brten pa'i shes rab nyid/ /de la bu yi ngang du byung*/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /

mkha' spyod kyi zhing ni/ zhi ba rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku sems dpa' sar bzhugs pa rnams la snang ba/ de bzhin khro tshul dkyil 'khor dpag tu med/ /mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'phro ba'i mkha' spyod gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rigs lnga'i zhing khams nyid/ /gsang sngags grub la rab tu snang ba yin/ /'di ni deng sang bde chen mkha' spyod ces/ /mkhas grub rnams la rab tu grags pa yin/ /nang gsal las rang snang phyir gsal du bzhengs pa khro bo rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor las zla ba'i gzugs brnyan chur snang ba bzhin du gsang sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i gang zag tshe la dbang ba dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i rigs 'dzin rnams la dug lnga sbyong ba'i phyir sku dang ye shes lnga'i chos rang byung du snang ba las/ gti mug 'dul ba'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi khro bo bud+dha he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor 'og min du gsal zhing*/ der bgrod nas mkha' 'gro dang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rig pa 'dzin pa gzhan rnams dang skal pa gcig pas tshogs kyi dga' ba dang sngags kyi lta spyod rlabs po che la spyod pa'o/ /de bzhin du rdo rje'i zhing na badz+ra he ru ka dang*/ rin po che'i zhing na rat+na he ru ka dang*/ pad+ma'i zhing na pad+ma he ru ka dang*/ las kyi zhing na karma he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor dang zhing gi bkod pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro grub pa can gyi grogs dang*/ mkha' la spyod pa dang*/ sa la spyod pa dang*/ sngags las skyes pa dang*/ zhing skyes la sogs pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang skal pa mnyam zhing*/ stong grogs byed pas 'chi kar zhing der gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang rol mo'i sprin phung gis bsu zhing*/ rigs 'dzin gyi bla ma rnams kyis gzigs nas drangs te rigs 'dzin gyi gral la 'jog pa'i gnas lnga ni bde chen mkha' spyod ces grags te/ sa thob pa rnams dang skal ba mtshungs pa'i zhing dang chos dang ston pa dang grogs su gcig pas rang rang gi lta ba dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dngos grub can gang na spyod pa las gzhan zhig tu mi bsam ste/

rin chen rgya mtsho las/ sar bzhugs rnams la snang ba bzhin/ /rig pa 'dzin la khro bo'i zhing*/ /mkha' spyod yon tan tshogs chen po/ /grub pa'i mtshan mas brgyan pa zhig /dngos grub ya mtshan chen por snang*/ /zhes so/ /'di nyid du lam sbyong ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje bla ma rnams bzhugs so zhes grags pa yin no/ /'gro 'dul sprul sku la bdun las/ thub ba drug tu bstan pa ni/ gnyis pa 'gro 'dul sprul pa yang 'gro ba so so'i gnas ris su de'i snang ba dang mthun pas don mdzad pa'i ston par snang ba ni/ sngar smos pa bzhin 'og min gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i gnas drug nas 'od zer drug 'gro ba drug gi gnas su 'phros pa'i rtse mo las yi ge 'phreng ba'i 'khor lo so so'i ston par snang bas don mdzad do zhes shes par bya ba ni/ longs sku'i zhing*/ de nyid ngang las 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku/ /'gro drug gnas su rang rang ston par snang*/ /de yang brgya byin thags bzang ris dang ni/ /shākya thub pa seng ge rab brtan dang*/ /kha 'bar de ba a wa glang mgo se/ /thub ba drug gis phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams su/ /'gro ba drug gi rgyud drug so sor sbyong*/ /longs sku'i 'od zer las yi ge 'phreng ba'i 'khor lo 'gro ba drug gi gnas su ston par 'phros te/ lha'i gnas su dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa lha'i thub pa dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gnas su thags bzangs ris la sogs pa dang*/ mi'i gnas su thub pa chen po la sogs pa dang*/ dud 'gro'i gnas su seng ge rab brtan la sogs pa dang*/ yi dgas kyi gnas su kha 'bar de ba la sogs pa dang*/ dmyal ba'i gnas su a wa glang mgo la sogs pa so so'i 'dul byed gang yin par lhun gyis grub pas/ g.yo ba dang 'bad pa'i rtsol ba mi mnga' bzhin du sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni thugs rje chen po'i byin gyis brlabs dang*/ 'gro ba'i dkar po rnam par 'phel ba'i rgyu las byung ba ste chu dang zla gzugs dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum dang chos mtshungs par snang ste/

zla ba la gzugs brnyan 'jog pa'i nus pa yod pa ltar longs sku'i zla ba la gdul bya'i ngor sprul pa 'byung ba'i nus pa yod pa dang*/ chu snod la gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa'i nus pa yod pa ltar gdul bya la sprul pa snang ba'i bsod nams yod pa dang*/ de gnyis 'dzom dus chu zla 'bad rtsol med par 'char ba ltar gdul bya yod dus ston pa'i zla ba las sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan skad cig kyang mi yol bar 'byung ba ste/ las brgya pa las/ rgya mtsho chu srin gnas kyi rlabs/ /dus las yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol mi mnga'/ /zhes pa ltar phyogs bzhi steng 'og dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkha'i mthas klas pa drug gi steng 'og phyogs mtshams dang bcas pa na 'gro ba drug bli snyed yod pa dag rang gi las kyis/ mtho ris rnams gyen du mgo bstan nas 'gro ba dang*/ dud 'grol phred la bstan pa dang*/ dmyal ba yi dwags mthur la bstan nas 'gro ba bde sdug sna tshogs la spyod pa bli snyed pa thams cad kyi don mdzad pa la thub pa grangs med tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa snang ba ni/ gsang snying las/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las thugs rje chen po'i byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i skyes bu thub pa drug /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las 'thon to/ /'thon nas kyang las kyi dbang gis snrel gzhi dang yan man gyi 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po re rer/ thub pa chen po bcom ldan 'das re rer 'dul ba rnam pa bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad de zhes so/ /'dul ba bzhi ni sku bsod nams chen pos 'dul ba dang*/ gsung theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos kyis 'dul ba dang*/ thugs mngon par shes pa chen pos 'dul ba dang*/ 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'dul

ba'o/ /yon tan ni kun la khyab pas logs su ma bgrangs so/ /dang po ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pas 'dul ba ste/ rgyud bla las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*/ /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*/ /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang*/ /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*/ /btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang*/ /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang*/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*/ /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes so/ /gsung gis 'dul ba ni/ snga ma las/ 'dul ba'i dbang gis lha dang mi'i theg pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ rang byang chub kyi theg pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa dang*/ /bla na med pa'i theg pas ma rig pa'i rnam par rtog pa nyon mongs pa stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gnyen por chos stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gsungs so/ /gsung ngo*/ /gsung bar 'gyur ro zhes so/ /de'ang shākya thub pa lta bu'i 'khor gyi khyams su gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cus rang rang gi mos pa ci yod pa de 'dra ba gsung gcig las dus gcig tu sems can tha dad kyi bsam pas chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa snga phyi med par sgra brnyan bzhin du thos par 'gyur ro/ /sprul sku'i gsung ltar snang yang sgra tshig rang mtshan pa med de/ gdul bya'i blo dang sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs las rang snang ba nyid/ rgyud bla las/ ji ltar sgra brnyan gyi ni sgra/ /gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung ba/ /rnam rtog med cing bzo med pa/ /phyi dang nang na mi gnas ltar/ /de ltar de bzhi gshegs pa'i gsung*/

/gzhan gyi rnam rig las byung pa/ /rnam par rtog med bzo med cing*/ /phyi dang nang na gnas ma yin/ /zhes so/ /gsung de nyid gdul bya'i rna bar yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs su thob pa ste/ dgongs 'dus las/ 'di lta ste/ tshangs pa lta bu dang*/ sil snyan lta bu dang*/ glu gar lta bu dang*/ ka la piṅka lta bu dang*/ / 'brug gi dbyangs lta bu dang*/ sgra brnyan lta bu'o/ /laṅka'i bdag po/ yan lag ni 'di lta ste/ 'du shes bskyed pa dang*/ rnam par rig pa dang*/ mnyan par 'os pa dang*/ mi mthun pa med pa dang*/ shin tu zab pa dang*/ rjes su 'byung ba dang*/ gang gis mi tshugs pa dang*/ rna bar snyan pa dang*/ rnam par ma 'khrugs pa dang*/ shin tu gsal ba ste/ rnam grangs kyi sgo re re gang byung ba de dang der yan lag kun rdzogs par 'byung ngo zhes so/ /rtsa ba drug la yan lag bcu bcu 'jug pas drug cur 'gyur ro/ /de ltar drug cu po rnams kyi rang bzhin bcu ni/ de las/ laṅka'i bdag po/ de la rang bzhin gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ gdangs su che ba dang*/ yongs su khyab pa dang*/ go bar myur ba dang*/ the tshom gcod pa dang*/ gcig la gzigs pa mnyam pa dang*/ nyi tsher ston pa dang*/ kun nas 'jug pa dang*/ 'dun pa bskyed pa dang*/ khyad du zhugs pa dang*/ thams cad 'dul ba'o zhes so/ /rang bzhin bcu po re re la rtsa ba'i drug po bsgres na'ang drug cur 'gyur la/ drug cu drug cur bsgres pas dbyangs kyi yan lag stong du 'gyur bas dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho zhes bya'o/ /de ltar sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan mthong ba yang baiḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la brgya byin gyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar 'gro ba'i las dag pa'i sems snang la snang ba ste/ rgyud bla las/ ji ltar baiḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char/

/'gro bar gzugs brnyan 'char nub rnyog med dang*/ /rnyog pa'i rang sems rab 'jug dbang gis 'jug /ces so/ /thugs kyi 'dul ba ni/ gsang snying las/ dus bzhi kun du mkhyen pa dang*/ thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyud kun tu mkhyen pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi spyan gyis thams cad kun du gzigs pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi snyan gyis kun du gsan pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi tshogs kun du don spyod pa dang*/ zag pa med pa'i kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mngon par shes pa chen po drug dang zhes so/ /de'ang gzigs pa lha'i mig gi mngon shes/ gsan pa rna ba'i mngon shes/ zag med kyi mngon shes/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ dus bzhi mkhyen pa tshe rabs du ma dran pas sngon gyi gnas dran pa'i mngon shes/ rdzu 'phrul gang gis 'gro ba 'dul ba der ston pa rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang drug gi rim pa thams cad thugs kyi rjes su 'gro zhing mkhyen nas don mdzad pas thugs kyis 'dul ba yin no/ /'phrin las kyis 'dul ba ni/ de las/ kun tu sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ kun tu thugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ kun tu zhal bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ kun tu gsung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa grangs med pa phyogs bcur snang bar gyur to zhes so/ /de'ang de lta bu'i sku gsung thugs kyi rim pa re re'ang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs can gyis phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad khyab par don mdzad pa'o/ /de'ang sku gsung thugs gsum gyis dngos su don mdzad pa dang*/ 'phrin las kyis dngos dang brgyud pa thams cad nas mdzad pas tha dad du bshad pa yin no/ /sprul pa dang yang sprul bshad pa ni/ de ltar 'gro ba'i khams drug tu don mdzad pa'i thub pa drug smos pa/ de yang gtso bo'i grangs te sprul pa dang*/ /yang sprul rnams ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/

/ lha yi gnas su'ang gnas ris so so ru/ /tshangs dang dbang phyug 'og min bar snyed du/ /rang rang 'dul byed ston pa'i tshul rnams snang*/ /thub pa drug ces smos pa ni sems can gyi rigs drug tu 'dus pa 'dul ba la dgongs la/ dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa'i ming drug ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ dbyings nas sprul pa dang*/ sprul pa des kyang yang sems can gyi ngor sprul pa bkye ba tshad med pas don mdzad de/ lha'i gnas su'ang rgyal chen bzhi nas 'og min gyi bar lha gnas so so'i gtso bos 'dul ba byed/ gang la gang 'dul du bstan pa ni/ de bzhin du/ mi la'ang gang 'dul de la der snang ste/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rgyal po la sogs sprul nas mi rnams 'dul/ /lha min gnas su'ang so so'i 'dul byed dang*/ / dud 'gro'i ris su'ang bya la byar snang zhing*/ /ri dgas rnams la seng ge mchog la sogs/ /so so'i 'dul byed ston pa bsam mi khyab/ /de bzhin yi dgas dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du/ /rang rang mthun pa'i gzugs kyis don mdzad do/ /'di ltar mi'i 'jig rten du'ang thub pa gcig pur ma zad de/ rgyal rigs dang*/ bram ze dang*/ bud med la sogs pa tshad med pas 'dul zhing*/ thub pa gcig pus kyang nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ rgyal po la sogs par sprul nas don mdzad pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du dud 'gro la yang byas 'dul ba la bya/ ri dwags kyis 'dul ba la seng ge la sogs pa'o/ /dmyal ba dang yi dgas na'ang de dang mtshungs te sems can gyis gar khyab tu sangs rgyas kyi sprul pas don mdzad pa ste/ phal po che las/ kye rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa ni tshad med de 'gro ba gang gis 'dul ba de dang de'i gzugs dang kha dog dang ming gis don mdzad do/ /'di lta ste/ dbang sgyur gyi gnas su ni lha'i bdag po dbang sgyur du sprul nas dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par len du 'jug go zhes pa nas/

dge sbyong dang*/ bral ze dang*/ yi dgas dang*/ dmyal ba pa'i gzugs kyis 'dul ba rnams la'ang de'i gzugs su sprul zhing don mdzad do zhes so/ / ye shes kyis don mdzad tshul la'ang gnyis kyi/ so sor don mdzad tshul ni/ tshul/ de ltar 'gro 'dul rnams la ye shes gnyis/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rnam pa ste/ /chos nyid dang ni chos can ma 'dres par/ /so sor mkhyen nas gdul bya'i don gnyis mdzad/ /'gro ba 'dul ba dang mchog gi sprul pa'i ye shes ni/ chos nyid la ltos te ji lta ba dang*/ chos can la ltos te ji snyed pa mkhyen pa ste/ mkhyen tshul ni/ 'di ltar/ ji lta'i ye shes stong pa'i mngon mkhyen nas/ /'gro la nye bar zhi ba'i chos ston zhing*/ /ji snyed ye shes sems dang dbang po sogs/ /ma 'dres mkhyen nas chos tshul bsam yas ston/ /de'ang chos nyid stong pa'i ngo bo nyid du mkhyen nas sems can rnams la rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i chos ston to/ /yum bar ma las/ kye sems can dag tshur shog /chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa ste khyed ci zhig gis nyon mongs pa zhes chos ston cing stong pa nyid la so sor rtog la zhes so/ /ji snyed pas gdul bya'i khams dang dbang po dang bag la nyal thams cad gzigs nas de dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa ste/ de nyid las/ ngas sems can gyi khams la rnam par gzigs nas sems can kun nas nyon mongs pa can de dag gi nyon mongs pa rab tu gdul ba'i phyir chos bstan to zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /

ma dag pa'i 'gro la snang tshul ni/ de ltar thub pa drug gis sprul pa/ 'di ni ma dag 'gro la snang ba ste/ /zhing ni 'gro drug 'jig rten drug rnams su/ /ston pa 'gro 'dul rang snang mthun pa yis/ /chos ni ma nges theg pa sna tshogs nyid/ /dus ni gdul bya'i skal ba mtshungs par snang*/ /de yang sprul sku'i gnas ni sems can gyi snang ba'i gnas gang yin par/ ston pa de'i snang ba dang mthun pas/ chos kyang sems can gyi blo rtog dang dbang po tha dad pa'i dbang gis theg pa sna tshogs su ston pa gnas dang 'khor rnams tshogs pa'i dus der gsungs so/ /kun byed las/ sprul pa'i sku yis 'dul ba'i zhing khams ni/ /'dzam bu'i gling ni bye ba phrag brgya sogs/ /rang byung ye shes thugs rjes rgyud drug 'dul/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa ni/ /'dul ba nyi khri chig stong gsungs pa yin/ /zhe sdang 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsung pa ni/ /mdo sde nyi khri chig stong gsungs pa yin/ /gti mug 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa ni/ /mngon pa'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /dug gsum cha mnyam 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /sde snod gsum mnyam nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /spyi ru brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yang*/ /dug gsum gnyen pos 'dul phyir gsungs pa yin/ /zhes so/ / ma dag pa'i snang pa la shar tshul ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i tshul/ de ltar 'gro drug 'jig rten drug po yang*/ /las dang bag chags dge sdig rgyu 'bras kyis/ /bde sdug mtho dman rnam pa sna tshogs nyid/ /ston pa drug kyang 'gro sems 'ang snang ste/ /rmi lam nang gi sangs rgyas sems can bzhin/ /ngo bo dag kyang rnam pa ma dag pas/ /sna tshogs snang la thugs rje'i rol par shar/ /'gro ba'i las dang bag chags dge bas mtho ris dang*/ mi dge bas ngan song du 'khor zhing bde sdug sna tshogs su myong ba rmi lam nang gi snang ba lta bu 'di ni ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs ba'i sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs dang*/

rang rang gi dge ba'i las kyi snang ba la sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa thub pa bcom ldan la sogs pas don mdzad pa de yang rmi lam lta bu ste/ sems can gyi rang snang las don ma grub pa nyid rmi lam du sprul pa bkye ba bzhin snang ba yin te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ ngas ni rmi lam lta bu'i 'gro ba la/ /rmi lam lta bur sprul nas chos bstan yang*/ /ngo bo med de rang bzhin gnyis su med/ /bdag med stong pa gsog tu rig par bya/ /zhes dang*/ yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor/ chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu zhes so/ /'khrul snang gi snod bcud brdzun pa ltar de la snang ba'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa'ang brdzun la/ yod pa ma yin pa ste med bzhin snang ba'i phyir rmi lam gyi sangs rgyas dang sems can bzhin no/ /des na 'khor 'das rmi lam lta bur snang dus 'dir ngo bo ye nas dag pa'i sangs rgyas yin yang*/ rnam pa 'gro drug gi sems can dang*/ de 'dul ba'i ston pa'ang de dag gi gzugs ngan pa la sogs par snang ba'i phyir ro/ /snang yang dbyings gcig gdod nas dag pas gnyis su med pa ste/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas med cing chos dang dge 'dun med/ /de ltar sus shes de ni mkhas pa yin/ /sems can rang bzhin byang chub nyid du gsungs/ /byang chub rang bzhin sems can thams cad de/ /sems can rnams dang byang chub gnyis ma yin/ /de ltar sus shes skyes bu mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i sems can la sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes gzigs pa yang gdul bya dang 'dun byed du 'brel nas don mdzad de/ log rtog bag chags dang bcas pa dag nas dbyings su zhi ba brnyes kyang ye shes brtse ba chen pos sems can thams cad sa ler gzigs nas/ don med pa la bdag tu gzung bas 'khrul pa rnams snying rje'i yul du dgongs te thabs kyis 'dren zhing lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad pa yang 'bad rtsol med par rang gis 'byung ba'i nus pa ye ldan du shar bas don mdzad pa nyid/

gsang snying las/ log par rtog brtags rnam dag cing*/ /ye shes dbyings las mi gzhan phyir/ /thugs rje chen pos 'brel bas na/ /'gro drug dus gnas ma lus snang*/ /zhes so/ / de dag kyang tshad med pa'i thugs rje ldan pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku chen po rnam pa drug po/ /'di ni tshad med thugs rje'i sprul pa yin/ /srid pa ji srid 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /dbyings kyi ngang nas ye shes kyi ngo bo tshad med pa'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs las rang snang ba'i sprul pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa de yang*/ gdul bya'i khams dang*/ de 'dul ba'i thabs dang*/ de'i gnyen po dang*/ dus la bab pa na bsnyel ba mi mnga' bar 'dul bas don mdzad pa yang 'bad rtsol med par chu zla snang ba ltar 'byung ste/ rgyud bla las/ gdul bya'i khams dang gdul ba'i thabs dang ni/ /gdul bya'i khams kyis 'dul ba'i bya ba dang*/ /de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la/ /khyab bdag rtag tu lhun gyis grub par 'jug /ces so/ /de'ang ngan song pa dag mtho ris la bkod nas thar pa'i sar 'dren pa dang*/ mtho ris pa dag gi'ang gnod 'tshe skyob cing phan bde mdzad nas thar pa la 'god pa dang*/ lam la ma zhugs pa rnams 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs pa rnams gong nas gong du yon tan la sbyor ba dang*/ sa bcu'i rjes la sangs rgyas la dgod pa ste/ mdor na sems can la ji lta bus skad cig tsam bde bar 'gyur ba de yang mdzad nas rim gyis byang chub gsum la so so'i skal pa ji lta ba bzhin 'god pas/ 'khor ba nas 'dren zhing sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i 'phrin las 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du dngos dang brgyud nas mdzad de/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las kyi rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod/ /ces so/ / rnam pa ni dpe dgus mtshon pa ste/ brgya byin mthong dus smon pa skye ba ltar sangs rgyas mthong nas sems dang bas smon zhing tshogs gnyis spyod pa dang*/

lha'i rnga sgras bag med pa las slong zhing 'jigs pa sel ba ltar chos kyi rnga sgras bag med pa dang 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*/ sprin ltar chos char 'bebs pas rgyud kyi dge ba spel ba dang*/ tshangs pa gnas las ma bskyod par lha'i gnas su snang ba ltar chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin du gzugs skus don mdzad pa dang*/ nyi ma ltar gdul bya'i pad+mo 'dzum zhing mun pa sel ba dang*/ nor bu ltar rnam par mi rtog pas gzhan don mdzad pa dang*/ sgra brnyan ltar dbyangs gcig drug cur go bas don mdzad dus nyid nas sgra tshig tu med pa dang*/ nam mkha' ltar rang bzhin spros pa med pa'i chos kyi skus 'char gzhi'i go phye bas don mdzad pa dang*/ sa ltar 'gro ba'i dge ba'i lo thog thams cad 'phel ba'i don mdzad pa ste/ rgyud bla las/ gang zhig brgya byin rnga dang sprin bzhin dang*/ /tshangs nyi rin chen yid bzhin nor rgyal bzhin/ /sgra brnyan nam mkha' sa bzhin srid pa'i bar/ /'bad med gzhan don byed de rnal 'byor rigs/ /rin chen lha dbang snang bzhin ston pa ste/ / legs par 'doms mdzad lha yi rnga dang 'dra/ khyab bdag mkhyen dang brtse chen sprin tshogs ni/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba srid rtse'i bar du khyab/ /tshangs bzhin zag med gnas las mi bskyod par/ /sprul pa rnam pa du ma rab tu ston/ /nyi bzhin ye shes snang ba rab spro gang*/ /rnam dag rin chen yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung de brag ca bzhin du yi ge med/ / sku ni nam mkha' lta bur khyab dang gzugs med rtag pa nyid/ /sa bzhin 'gro ba'i dkar po'i chos kyi sman rnams ma lus pa'i/ /rnam pa kun tu gzhir gyur pa ni sangs rgyas sa yin no/ /zhes so/ / sna tshogs sprul sku la gsum las/ bzo sprul pas 'gro don phun sum tshogs par mdzad tshul ni/ sprul pa'i sku gsum pa ni bems por snang bas don mdzad pa sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis sprul pa dang*/

'gro 'dul la sogs pas de ltar sprul pa yin no zhes bshad pa yang*/ 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i dus dang ye shes kyis don mdzad pa nam mkha' lta bu'i phrin las phun sum tshogs pa/ de nyid ngang las sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /sems med bems po'i tshul gyis snang ba ste/ /ris su bris dang 'bur dang rang byon dang*/ /yi ge la sogs mchod pa'i rten dang ni/ /pad+ma dpag bsam shing dang skyed mos tshal/ khang bzangs mchog dang kun dga'i ra ba dang*/ /sprul pa'i grong dang gru gzings zam pa dang*/ /mar me nor bu zas gos bzhon pa sogs/ /'gro ba'i don mang byed pa'i bems por snang*/ /ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i skus don mdzad pa'i bye brag la/ ris su bris pa dang*/ 'bur du dod pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rang byon du snang ba dang*/ yi ge dang*/ lha dang mchod rten la sogs pa gang zhig mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa'i gdung shugs g.yo bas thar pa'i sa bon 'jog pa dang*/ des mtshon nas de 'dra'i rten gyis rnam pa thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i rgyud la dge ba spel bas sangs rgyas kyi sprul par bsdu ste/ snyan gyi gong rgyan du/ da ni snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshe/ / bzo dang yi ge'i gzugs su 'dug /nga yin snyam du dad par byos/ /zhes pa dang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ bzo dang skyed dang byang chub che/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtag ston pas/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen no/ /zhes so/ /bzo ni bzo'i rnam par snang ba bshad ma thag pa rnams so/ /skye ba ni sems can la dngos su phan pa de'i lus su sprul pa ste/ mu ge'i tshe nya bau che dang*/ nad kyi tshe srog chags des pa dang*/ srin mo'i gling du rta'i rgyal po ba la ha la sogs par sprul nas don mdzad pa'o/ /mchog gi sprul pa ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'o/ /de bzhin du pad+ma dang*/
